summary: Members of Congress answer an address by pointing to the guest they brought and what happened to that guest.
realLife: After a president's joint address, local coverage showed several House members and senators of the other party answering with a guest they had invited, such as a fired federal worker, a teacher of the year or a union leader for firefighters, and with local costs such as tariffs, plant jobs and Medicaid. The president's party answered with a statement of praise and a charge that the other side had disrupted the speech.
sources: WFSB (Hartford, Connecticut), 'Local reactions, debates ensue following President Trump's address to Congress', March 5, 2025: https://www.wfsb.com/2025/03/05/local-reactions-president-trumps-congressional-address-sparks-debate/
